aboutSubheading: Your vision. Our expertise. A home you'll love forever.
aboutText: Ocean Blue Builders has been designing and constructing premium custom homes across Melbourne for over 15 years. Based in Balwyn, our experienced team of builders, designers and project managers work closely with homeowners throughout the eastern suburbs and greater Melbourne to deliver bespoke living spaces that blend quality craftsmanship with modern design. We take pride in our transparent communication, on-time delivery, and a build process that puts you at the centre of every decision.

servicesSubheading: Comprehensive building solutions for every stage of your home journey.
servicesText: Whether you're starting from scratch with a brand new build, extending your current home, or embarking on a luxury renovation, Ocean Blue Builders has the expertise to deliver outstanding results. We manage every aspect of the process — from initial design concepts and council approvals through to final handover — so you can enjoy a stress-free building experience.

testimonials.text: Ocean Blue Builders made the whole process of building our dream home in Glen Waverley an absolute breeze. From the initial design meeting to handover, communication was brilliant and the quality of work is outstanding. Couldn't recommend them more highly.
testimonials.name: James Whitford

testimonials.text: We had our 1960s bungalow in Box Hill completely renovated and extended by the Ocean Blue team. The result is absolutely stunning — it feels like a brand new home. They kept us informed every step of the way and finished right on schedule.
testimonials.name: Sarah Nguyen

testimonials.text: As a property developer, I've worked with many builders across Melbourne, and Ocean Blue Builders is hands down the best. Their multi-unit project in Bentleigh was delivered ahead of time and the finish quality exceeded expectations. Already planning our next one with them.
testimonials.name: David Caruso
